candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for common prefixes and single-letter grammatical particles in Hebrew and Arabic.
This vector represents Italian adverbial suffixes and related morphological endings.
This vector represents common Spanish nominal and verbal suffixes or root endings.
This vector activates on closing punctuation marks and various combinations of quotes, parentheses, and commas used at the ends of sentences or clauses.
This feature vector activates strongly on text tokens starting with the letters "ass" or their close textual and phonetic variations.
This vector represents words containing the phonetic or orthographic root "mass" or related lexical fragments.
This feature vector represents concepts related to variety, difference, and distinctness across multiple languages.
This vector represents inflectional forms, roots, and proper name fragments related to the concept of activity, activation, or being active across multiple languages.
These tokens represent accented characters commonly used in various alphabets, particularly vowels with acute accents.
This vector represents quantifying determiners, numbers, and indefinite adjectives across multiple languages.
